name: finello
description: Local monthly finance tracker: import bank/card statements, auto-categorise, export to Expense Tracker format.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
